about_short_description.short_description: Cargomatic is a platform for connecting local shippers and local truckers in real-time.

product.name: Local Freight Marketplace
product.description: A digital platform connecting local shippers with professional truck drivers for real-time freight matching and transportation.

product.name: Drayage Services
product.description: Transportation service specializing in moving freight between ports and local destinations within the top 20 U.S. ports.

product.name: Intermodal Shipping Solutions
product.description: A service enabling shippers to coordinate freight movement across air, ground, rail, and sea transportation modes.

product.name: Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) Shipping
product.description: A freight service matching shippers with appropriate equipment and capacity for partial truckload shipments.

product.name: Full Truckload (FTL) Shipping
product.description: A freight service connecting shippers with trucks and trailers for full truckload shipments locally, regionally, and nationally.

product.name: White Glove Delivery Service
product.description: A delivery service for in-home and direct-to-consumer shipments involving large or delicate items requiring special handling.
